cluster_label: arista and sacculus thermosensory and hygrosensory neuron Ir21a, Ir40a, Gr28b
working_definition: Thermosensory and hygrosensory neurons of the arista and sacculus named by Ir21a, Ir40a and Gr28b (Li et al. 2022 FCA, Manual Annotation).
searches_performed: arista and sacculus thermosensory and hygrosensory neuron Ir21a, Ir40a, Gr28b

best_match.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron of the antenna that detects a stimulus via one or more receptors and projects to the antennal lobe (Schlegel et al., 2021). This includes antennal olfactory, thermosensory and hygrosensory neurons (Schlegel et al., 2021).

justification: Grouped thermo- and hygrosensory call. OLS ancestors verified: adult hygrosensory neuron Ir40a (FBbt:00110990), adult thermosensory neuron Ir21a VP1l (FBbt:00111336) and aristal sensory neuron VP2 (FBbt:00007575, Gr28b thermosensory) all have adult antennal lobe receptor neuron as an ancestor. No shared thermo/hygro class exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult thermosensory neuron expressing Ir21a, glomerulus VP1l.
Aristal thermosensory neuron projecting to VP2.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Single member; Gr28b link is an inference.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult sensory neuron that receives sensory input in the antenna.

recommendation: Map broadly to FBbt:00051494 (medium confidence); only 2 nuclei.
